title: Fundamentals
exercise: Try conversing with the model, ask what operators, variables and data types are.

title: Variable
exercise: Store your age in a variable and print it.

title: Sum operation using print()
exercise: Print the addition of 12 and 6 using print().

title: Subtraction operation using print()
exercise: Print the subtraction of 12 by 6 using print().

title: Multiplication operation using print()
exercise: Print the multiplication of 12 and 6 using print().

title: Division operation using print()
exercise: Print the division of 12 by 6 using print().

title: Errors
exercise: Try dividing 12 by 0 and read the error message. What kind of error is it?

title: Division using variables
exercise: Set variable a to 12 and b to 6 and divide a by b, print the output.

title: User input
exercise: Use the input() function to set the values of the variables yourself and print them.

title: Mini calculator
exercise: Get 2 variables using the input() function and add, subtract, multiply and divide them, print the output.

title: Modulus operator
exercise: Use the modulus (%) operator on 2 variables.

title: if / else
exercise: Use if and else to see if a given number is even or odd.

title: if / elif / else ladder
exercise: Check if a number is less than 0, greater than 0 or equal to 0 using if elif else.

title: match case
exercise: Use match case to print the day of the week depending on user input (i.e., input = 1, day = Sunday).

title: for loops
exercise: Print the multiplication table of a number the user enters.

title: for loop 2
exercise: Use a for loop to print every 2nd number from 1 to 99 using the range() function.

title: while loops
exercise: Build a number guessing game (secret number 7) that repeats until correct.

title: Project
exercise: Chat with the AI and decide on a project, then build it.
